_read_me: Ready-made products to sell from CJdropshipping's US warehouses. Find candidates with: CJ_API_KEY=... node scripts/cj-import.mjs --search "menorah". Add one entry per product with its CJ product ID (pid), then run the script without flags to import. price is optional: leave it out to use cost x markup. Only variants in stock in a US warehouse are imported.

_example.name: LED Menorah
_example.blurb: Battery-powered menorah with nine switchable candles. Safe for kids' rooms and windows.
